NBT Companion 1.1.0 - first public release

One Windows program (a single exe, x64, nothing to install) for BMW / MINI / Toyota Supra NBT EVO (ID5/ID6) head units:
automatic connection over the ENET cable (standard addresses, ID5/ID6 default password), reads the unit's software
version and brand, SSH open/close (Xayanix's script, downloaded on your PC, not included), install / update / restore
of NBT-AAD with checks before anything is written, menu entries in MINI Connected / ConnectedDrive, home screen tile,
former CarLife look, nbt-aad.env editor, diagnostics, NBT Plus apps, the apps of nbt-evo-apps that run on the head
unit (MINI Sport and the next ones) and one Updates page. Italian and English.

Status
- NBT Plus (iDrive plugins and phone apps): tested
- MINI Sport (nbt-evo-apps): tested
- NBT Companion, home screen tile, former CarLife look, the other nbt-evo-apps apps: under development
- NBT-AAD: third party (Sq00ky / nanaisu)
The nbt-evo-apps apps are installed from the latest nbt-evo-apps release that has the stick zip (nbt-evo-apps*.zip).
So far only the connection and the SSH check of NBT Companion have been tried in a car; every head-unit script was run
against a simulated unit.

Requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, ENET cable (network adapter with a 169.254.x.x address), Python 3 only to open/close SSH.
The app never reboots the head unit and never saves the password. It updates itself from the releases of this
repository (it asks first). The exe is not code-signed, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning.

---

Prima release pubblica. Un solo exe Windows per le NBT EVO (ID5/ID6): collegamento automatico via ENET (indirizzi
standard, password predefinita ID5/ID6), lettura della versione software e della marca della testata, apertura/chiusura
SSH, installazione/aggiornamento/ripristino di NBT-AAD con controlli prima di scrivere, voci in MINI Connected /
ConnectedDrive, casella nella home, grafica ex CarLife, nbt-aad.env, diagnostica, app NBT Plus, app di nbt-evo-apps
che girano sulla testata (MINI Sport e le prossime) e pagina Aggiornamenti.
Testati: NBT Plus e MINI Sport. In sviluppo: NBT Companion, casella, grafica ex CarLife, le altre app di nbt-evo-apps.
NBT-AAD e' di terzi. Le app di nbt-evo-apps si installano dall'ultima release di nbt-evo-apps con lo zip della chiavetta.
In auto finora provati solo il collegamento e il controllo SSH di NBT Companion. La testata non viene mai riavviata
dall'app; la password non viene mai salvata.
